name: 발룸

tail: 양옆으로 갈라진 두 갈래의 촉수 꼬리
accessories: 머리 위에 떠 있는 빛나는 마법 핵

unique_features: 머리 위의 떠 있는 마법 핵
몸 곳곳에 박힌 하얀 뼈 조각
visual_en: A small 2-head tall creature facing right, featuring a large floating luminous cyan magic core above its head. The face is a massive, dark teal gaping mouth without eyes. The body is made of translucent cyan slime with sharp white bone fragments embedded throughout. Two large, thick tentacles split from the lower body to form a bifurcated tail. The creature's skin glows with a bright neon cyan light, contrasting against dark bone armor pieces. Small bubbles and glowing particles drift around the central core and the split tail tips.
pose_en: A writhing, unstable stance as if about to split in half.
vfx_en: Splashing neon cyan liquid droplets and bright white light bursts.
weapon_en: Sharp, jagged bone blades protruding from the body.
